name: knitting-toolkit
description: A knitter's toolkit: gauge-to-size advisor and yarn substitution / mixing finder.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
